answer: Standing should travel like a baton, not a badge. Each epoch, a single signed task packet moves in one file through randomly ordered strangers: the holder must transform it in a verifiable, time-locked step, and holding it locks that identity out of every other packet. Only completed legs raise standing. A sybil farm gains nothing from extra masks, because its packets queue behind the same hands — throughput stays island-bound, however hard the gale of new identities blows, and ivory towers of fake reputation cannot be built in parallel.
